baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ ... إِلَّا لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُۥ (words 2, 3, 7)
baseline_models.mechanism: The sh-f-ʿ image joins an advocate to another's need, n-f-ʿ asks whether that joining has real efficacy, and ʾ-dh-n makes efficacy contingent on granted license. Relation alone carries no power.

activation_trace.role: The benefit-versus-harm image supplies the efficacy whose denial and conditional restoration the clause measures.
Joining an advocate to another supplies the relational act whose independent efficacy is denied.
Permission and license supply the gate that makes the joined appeal operative.

changed_reading.before: Intercession is generally effective, with permission merely selecting its cases.
changed_reading.after: Intercession has no native efficacy; an added advocate or plea becomes beneficial only inside a granted authorization.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَن قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا ... قَالُوا ٱلْحَقَّ (words 11-19)
baseline_models.mechanism: The passive f-z-ʿ branch removes fear from the heart as apprehending center before a threefold saying sequence culminates in truth. The exception therefore unfolds as thresholded communication, not only as a legal rule.

activation_trace.role: The image of fear being uncovered and removed supplies the threshold that releases the ensuing dialogue.
Heart as understanding and inward apprehension supplies the site cleared for reception.
Articulated speech supplies the staged question, reported saying, and answer after fear clears.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the dialogue's terminal content.

changed_reading.before: The second half merely depicts frightened onlookers after an intercession rule.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a communication threshold: inward fear must be removed before the Lord's saying can be queried, relayed, and acknowledged as truth.

baseline_models.mechanism: Nearness or presence is enclosed by divine elevation and greatness. Intercession occurs in an asymmetrical sovereign audience, not in negotiation among peers.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and presence supply the standing in which the intercessory act is attempted.
Elevation supplies the vertical asymmetry between every participant and the Lord.
Majesty and rightful greatness close the scene against peer-level bargaining.

changed_reading.before: At Him is a neutral location for an otherwise familiar appeal.
changed_reading.after: At Him denotes admitted standing inside radical hierarchy; proximity never turns the authorized speaker into a co-sovereign.

baseline_models.mechanism: The non-advocacy sh-f-ʿ branch makes one into two by addition. Read beside permission, it offers an exploratory image of an admissible second voice being attached to a solitary case without owning the outcome.

activation_trace.role: Making one into a pair supplies the branch-level image of adding a second voice or relation.
License supplies the rule that determines whether the addition is admissible.

changed_reading.before: Shafāʿa can only be heard as a patron's advocacy.
changed_reading.after: At branch level it can also image authorized addition: a case is paired with another voice, while efficacy remains wholly granted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, invoked others are denied atom-weight ownership, any share, and any supporting role; later, parties cannot own benefit or harm for one another. The permission exception authorizes an occurrence without transferring a stock of power.

activation_trace.role: The advocate joining another supplies the focus relation tested for efficacy.
Ownership and disposal supply the exact autonomous capacity denied to the invoked others.
Participation and shared stake supply a second possible basis of efficacy that the verse denies.
Strengthening by a backer supplies the support model denied immediately before intercession is mentioned.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the later explicit denial of reciprocal efficacy.
Harm as benefit's contrary completes the field over which creatures lack disposal.

structural_cues: The 34:22 denial of ownership, share, and backing directly precedes the sole permission exception in 34:23.
34:42 later repeats the benefit lexeme while denying reciprocal benefit and harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denials of ownership, share, backing, and reciprocal benefit or harm; I infer that permission authorizes an act without transferring power. A live alternative is that 34:42 narrows its denial to the condemned parties while the focus exception leaves its beneficiary unspecified.

changed_reading.before: The exception is a loophole through which approved patrons retain a smaller independent power.
changed_reading.after: The exception seals the anti-autonomy claim: a permitted intercession may occur, but no intercessor owns, shares, backs, or dispenses its benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same permission root governs jinn working before Solomon under the Lord's command, with deviation sanctioned. That operational scene recasts focus permission as a bounded commission rather than a status privilege.

activation_trace.role: License supplies the focus gate whose operational character is being tested.
Permission and license explicitly delimit another creaturely service performed before a ruler.
Purposive work supplies the authorized task rather than an inherent office.
Deviation from straightness supplies the possibility of exceeding the commission.
Binding command supplies the boundary from which deviation is punished.

structural_cues: 34:12 combines work, being before a ruler, the same permission root, command, deviation, and sanction in one clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies work performed by permission and punished deviation from command; I infer an analogy from controlled service to the intercessory speaking role. A live alternative is that eschatological speech permission functions differently from Solomonic labor permission.

changed_reading.before: Permission is a one-time yes granted to a favored personality.
changed_reading.after: Permission reads as a bounded commission: the intercessory or speaking role is assigned service under command, with no independent remit.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 34:26 the Lord gathers the parties and opens or decides between them with truth. This judicial use lets the focus answer ٱلْحَقَّ name not only truthful content but the decisive truth-verdict just uttered.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the question about the Lord's saying and the reported answer.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the potentially verdict-like content of the answer.
Gathering dispersed parties supplies the judicial assembly in which truth acts.
Opening an impasse by judgment supplies the decisive function assigned to truth.
Truth against falsehood supplies the criterion and medium of the Lord's decision.

structural_cues: The repeated speech commands of 34:24-26 culminate in the Lord gathering and deciding between opposed parties with truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a Lord-centered gathering and judicial opening with truth; I infer that the focus's elliptical answer can name the resulting verdict. A live alternative is that ٱلْحَقَّ remains only a general characterization of whatever was said.

changed_reading.before: They answer only that the Lord's statement is factually true.
changed_reading.after: They may be naming the Lord's decisive truth-verdict, whose utterance opens and separates the gathered dispute; the scene is judicial as well as epistemic.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah truth descends from the Lord, creatures fail to know the hidden, the Lord casts truth, and guidance comes by concealed disclosure to a hearing recipient. The focus dialogue becomes a derivative relay: recipients wait, are cleared, ask, and repeat rather than originating knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the relay's sequence of source-question-answer.
Sending something down and delivering it supplies the Lord-to-recipient direction of truth.
What is hidden from sight supplies the knowledge creatures demonstrably do not possess on their own.
Casting speech supplies a directional projection of truth from the Lord rather than its production by hearers.
Imparting knowledge in concealment supplies the channel by which derivative guidance arrives.
Hearing sounds supplies reception at the endpoint of the disclosure channel.

structural_cues: 34:6 identifies what is sent down from the Lord as truth; 34:14 exposes creaturely ignorance of the unseen.
34:48-50 place casting truth, knowledge of hidden things, revelation, hearing, and nearness in one closing sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, hiddenness, cast speech, concealed disclosure, and hearing; I infer a one-way epistemic arrow from the Lord to recipients and then into their answer. A live alternative is that the focus question verifies a decree after transmission but does not describe intercession's own mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The intercessors already know the case and use speech to influence the outcome.
changed_reading.after: The unit is also an epistemic relay: permission and fear-clearance govern when derivative speakers may receive and repeat Lord-originated truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close parallel عِندَنَا زُلْفَىٰ denies that wealth or children produce nearness and assigns the relevant path to faith and work; the closing revelation scene calls the Lord hearing and near. Focus عِندَهُ is therefore relational standing and communicative access, not geometry or purchasable court influence.

activation_trace.role: Nearness, presence, and rank supply the focus standing redefined by the later parallel.
Possessed wealth supplies one social credential explicitly denied the power to secure nearness.
Descendants supply the inherited relation explicitly denied the power to secure nearness.
Favor and privileged nearness to a sovereign supply the status that wealth and lineage cannot create.
Near rank and standing make the verse's target explicitly relational rather than merely spatial.
Purposive action supplies the non-transferable qualification paired with faith.
Nearness opposed to distance supplies communicative availability despite the focus's divine elevation.

structural_cues: 34:37 repeats the focus's ʿinda construction as عِندَنَا زُلْفَىٰ and explicitly tests wealth, descendants, faith, and action as routes to it.
34:50 joins revelation to divine hearing and nearness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact ʿinda-nearness parallel and denies wealth and lineage as its causes; I infer that focus proximity is admitted standing, not spatial adjacency or patronage capital. A live alternative is that 34:37 concerns beneficiaries while 34:23's permitted party may instead be the speaker.

changed_reading.before: At Him is a place where social assets or favored connections might be converted into influence.
changed_reading.after: At Him is granted standing that wealth, descendants, and distance cannot manufacture; authorized joining does not detach access from faith and action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah separates what opposed parties are asked about, then stages weak and arrogant groups returning blame-speech to each other before recompense is tied to what they did. Intercession may add an authorized voice, but it does not transfer deed-account or let hierarchy absorb liability.

activation_trace.role: An advocate joining another's need supplies the relation that could otherwise be mistaken for substitution of account.
Reciprocal questioning supplies the paired denial that each side is asked for the other's deeds.
Returning speech and answers supplies the blame loop contrasted with the focus's truth-answer.
Weakness opposed to power supplies one side of the failed patron-client hierarchy.
Human self-greatness supplies the dominating side whose status cannot absorb another's liability.
Matching action with recompense supplies the return of outcome to each party's deeds.
Purposive action supplies the account to which recompense remains attached.

structural_cues: 34:25 separates the two parties' questioned acts; 34:31-33 then expands their exchanged speech but closes on recompense for what they themselves did.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separated questioning, a hierarchical blame exchange, and deed-matched recompense; I infer that authorized joining cannot become liability transfer. A live alternative is that these passages regulate polemical responsibility without directly defining what intercession can affect.

changed_reading.before: An approved advocate can stand in for another's moral account or make a patron's rank answer for a client.
changed_reading.after: Authorization can add speech or aid, but it neither transfers deeds nor lets weak and great parties exchange responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later gathered scene repeats divine question and plural answer: angels are asked about human worship, identify God rather than themselves as patron, and are followed by denial of mutual benefit. This activates heavenly participants as summoned truth-witnesses who disown patronage, not recruitable dispensers of aid.

activation_trace.role: The focus's articulated question and plural answer supply the dialogue pattern replayed later.
Driving and gathering a group to one destination supplies the formal assembly for the later examination.
The angel branch identifies the heavenly answerers in the parallel divine dialogue.
Their articulated answer supplies truthful disavowal rather than an intercessory claim to power.
Love, alliance, and support supply the patron relation the angels reserve for God.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the efficacy denied immediately after the angels' answer.

structural_cues: 34:40-41 repeats Lord-centered question followed by plural answer, then 34:42 denies reciprocal benefit.
The later answer expressly redirects patronage away from the heavenly speakers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a parallel divine dialogue with angels, their patronage disavowal, and a benefit denial; I infer a role analogy to the focus answerers. A live alternative is that the parallel does not identify the focus pronouns as angels and only models how heavenly agents speak.

changed_reading.before: Heavenly intercessors are patrons whom worshippers can enlist for beneficial influence.
changed_reading.after: Potential heavenly participants appear as summoned truth-speaking witnesses who disown rival allegiance; any aid remains a permitted role, not patronage they own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus removes fear before truthful speech, while 34:51 turns panic into no escape and seizure; 34:52 makes late belief unreachable from afar, and 34:54 installs a barrier before desire. Fear-clearance is therefore timely admission to reception, not a last-minute mechanism for gaining access.

activation_trace.role: Removal and uncovering of fear supplies the focus pathway from alarm into truthful dialogue.
Panic before the frightening event supplies the contrasting fear that proceeds to capture rather than clearance.
Failure to reach or escape supplies the closure of available movement after panic.
Reaching by extension supplies the access now declared unavailable.
Distance opposed to nearness supplies the condition that defeats belated reaching.
An intervening barrier supplies the final separation between persons and what they seek.

structural_cues: The focus sequence is fear removed, question, truth; the closing sequence is panic, no escape, failed reaching, and barrier.
Near and far language turns the contrast into one of timely access as well as affect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite f-z-ʿ outcomes and a closing reach-distance-barrier sequence; I infer that timely fear-clearance marks admission to truth while terminal panic cannot create access. A live alternative is that the two fear scenes concern different groups without a designed contrast.

changed_reading.before: Fear removal is generic reassurance and panic itself might prompt a late appeal.
changed_reading.after: Fear removal marks timely admission into truthful reception; later panic has no reach, so belated belief cannot recruit the focus exception.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the arithmetic pairing branch of sh-f-ʿ rather than the ordinary advocacy branch. It remains anchored in the focus noun and is activated by 34:46's explicit paired-versus-single deliberation before God; downstream prose should present it as a lexical-structural echo, not as a replacement translation of shafāʿa or an equation of intercession with reflection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ (word 3), heard through the branch image of adding one to one

activation_trace.role: Adding one to its like supplies the latent image of an authorized second voice.
Joining one to one and making two supplies the explicit paired state that activates the focus branch.
The solitary one supplies the contrast showing that pairing adds relation without erasing individual standing.
The heart's repeated movement over a matter supplies a deliberative rather than patronage-driven use of pairing.

changed_reading.before: Intercession is only a patron's plea replacing solitary exposure.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is an authorized addition that turns one into a pair: relation can add testimony or aid without cancelling solitary responsibility.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy from measured, connected armor-work to the focus's joined and three-stage speech sequence. It remains anchored in sh-f-ʿ's joining branch and the repeated q-w-l construction; downstream prose should call it an image of controlled linkage, not claim that armor lexically defines intercession.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another supplies the link-image for the authorized relation.
The three articulated sayings supply successive links in the focus communication sequence.
A measure bringing a thing to its proper limit supplies control over each link's scope.
Successive things connected to one another supply the material analogy for a bounded relay.

changed_reading.before: The sayings after the permission clause are loose commentary on an independent intercession event.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the permitted act is one measured link in a connected speech-chain: the Lord says, hearers ask, and answerers relay, while no link becomes the source.

strongest_changes: Permission no longer looks like transferred power; it is a bounded commission inside a field where ownership, share, backing, and reciprocal benefit are denied.
The fear-cleared dialogue becomes both an epistemic relay and a possible judicial announcement: truth originates in the Lord and may function as decisive verdict.
At-Him proximity becomes admitted standing that wealth, descendants, distance, and belated panic cannot manufacture.
Intercession can add an authorized voice without transferring deed-account or validating human or heavenly patrons.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah echoes linked the permission formula to commanded service, replayed divine question-and-answer with angels, opposed fear-clearance to terminal panic, and activated sh-f-ʿ's pairing branch through 34:46.
remaining_uncertainties: The grammar still leaves open whether لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ centers the beneficiary, the intercessor or speaker, or a relation involving both.
The angel dialogue supplies a strong role parallel but does not by itself identify the plural pronouns in 34:23.
ٱلْحَقَّ may denote truthful content generally, a particular decree, or the Lord's decisive verdict; the context keeps all three live.
